title: Design System: MapleRoyals HP Washing APR Optimizer

display.purpose: The four key figures on the specimen label.

table.purpose: Plan, key and reference tables, tabular figures.

caption.purpose: Figure terms, notes, footer, specimen tag, winner tag.

plate.purpose: Result section headings under a 1px ink rule (1.1rem inside the key).

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Background, colour and border changes on buttons and fields.

motion.name: result-in
motion.purpose: Result panel rises 4px from 0.3 opacity on each new result.

motion.name: run-pulse

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action: crimson, square, heavy.

components.name: Field
components.description: Stacked label, square input with tabular figures, ochre focus.

narrative.overview:
A washing plan is treated as a collected specimen. The page is a herbarium mount board in sage grey-green, structured by ink-green rules; the result is a specimen label pinned to it, read at a glance: a plan code on its tag, the headline line, a printed stamp for reached or missed, a measuring ruler against the HP target, and a ruled strip of four key figures. Policy behaviour is set as a field guide's dichotomous key numbered in level order, the four policies sit in a ruled comparison strip with the winner outlined, and the level-by-level plan is a plain ruled table under its own section plate. The dark appearance is the same cabinet at night: moss-black ground, bone text, the same crimson and ochre, lifted for contrast.

Density is that of a working reference sheet: compact tables, tabular figures everywhere numbers live, labels small and semibold, headings heavy. Everything is square and flat; depth comes from ground layers and 1px rules, never from shadow. Archivo sets every Latin glyph and figure; CJK deliberately uses the system Traditional Chinese face rather than a shipped CJK font. The world rejects both the generic dark gaming dashboard and the parchment-and-serif game skin.
keyCharacteristics: Paper grounds stacked by tone and outlined by 1px rules: in light the page card shares the mount's tone, so label white is the one raised paper.
Square corners on every surface; the drawn state mark is the one round form.
Crimson is the one action; ochre marks the specimen tag, the winner tag, selection, focus and caution; moss marks reached.
States are drawn printed marks: filled circle reached, hollow circle missed, ochre strike-through when stale.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Crimson fills only things you press to act (and the ruler fill that reports the action's outcome). Never use it as a decorative accent or a heading colour beyond `crimson-text` marks.

rules.name: The Three Inks Rule
rules.body: Saturated colour comes only from crimson, ochre and moss, each with a fixed meaning (act, mark/caution, reached). Add a new hue only with a new meaning.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number is set with tabular figures (inputs, tables, figures, captions) so columns align across rows and reruns.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: 800 for headings, figures, table headers, buttons and active tabs; 600 and below for the rest. No intermediate display weights.

rules.name: The Paper Stack Rule
rules.body: Raise an element by moving it up the ground stack (mount, sheet, label) and giving it a rule, never with a shadow.

rules.name: The Chosen Line Rule
rules.body: 2px ink is reserved for the answer: the specimen label and the winning comparison cell. Everything else takes 1px.

dos: Do keep every surface corner square (0) and every container flat, separated by 1px rules.
Do reserve crimson for the action and its outcome; mark everything else with ochre, moss or ink.
Do set every number in tabular figures.
Do show state as a drawn mark (a CSS circle, never a text glyph): filled for reached, hollow for missed, ochre strike-through for stale.
Do head each result section with a plate: 1.25rem/800 under a 1px ink rule.
Do report a measure against a target as a graduated ruler with quarter ticks and a target notch.
Do define every colour as a role token and give it a night value under both the media query and `[data-theme="dark"]`.
Do use the 2px ochre outline for focus everywhere.
donts: Don't add box-shadows or rounded corners to surfaces; depth is the paper stack, and the state mark is the only round form.
Don't ship a CJK webfont; Chinese text uses the system Traditional Chinese face.
Don't introduce a second typeface for display; Archivo at 800 is the display voice.
Don't reskin toward a dark gaming dashboard or a parchment-and-serif game look.
Don't use maple orange anywhere but the product name.
